A '''skirmish''' took place in [[1002 BBY]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. In that year, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]] of the [[Gloom Walkers]], a unit in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], was arrested by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ulabore]] for mutiny during the [[Battle of Phaseera]], despite the fact that Dessel had gone on to lead the Sith forces to victory. As a result, the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] of the Gloom Walkers felt dissent toward Ulabore. Shortly after, while on patrol on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], the unit was ambushed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces. Casualties were heavy on both sides, but the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] were soon forced to retreat. Over the course of the battle, Ulabore was shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]], a trooper in his unit. Afterward, the other members of the Gloom Walkers kept her betrayal a secret.

==Prelude==
In [[1002 BBY]], during the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] fought against the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phaseera]]. As the [[Battle of Phaseera|battle]] began, the [[Gloom Walkers]], an elite unit in the Brotherhood of Darkness, were ordered by their Sith commanders to attempt to take out a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] outpost in daytime. Knowing that it would be a suicide mission, the Gloom Walkers objected; however, their commander, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ulabore]], refused to reconsider their orders.<ref name="Rule" />

As such, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]] knocked Ulabore unconscious and took command of the unit, leading the Gloom Walkers to attack the outpost during the night. They defeated the Republic forces, and Dessel's heroics throughout the battle led him to become very popular with the Gloom Walkers; however, Ulabore was furious and had him arrested for insubordination.<ref name="Rule" /> Several of the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] in the unit assumed that Dessel was then court-martialed and killed. The Gloom Walkers thus began to resent Ulabore for his actions, as they believed that Dessel had saved their lives and should have been hailed as a hero.<ref name="Dynasty" />

==The skirmish==
A month later, the Gloom Walkers traveled to [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]],<ref name="Dynasty" /> a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the planet [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> They took up patrol on the moon, where they stumbled into an ambush set up by Republic forces&mdash;a mistake that one of the troopers, [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]], knew would not have happened had Dessel still been with them. In the ensuing skirmish, the close-quarters fighting was intense and casualties were heavy on both sides. Lucia hadn't forgiven the Gloom Walkers' commander for ridding the unit of their most talented [[Officer/Legends|officer]], and during the battle she shot Ulabore in the back from point-blank range, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him. The skirmish lasted for just a few minutes, after which the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] were forced to break ranks and flee.<ref name="Dynasty" />

==Aftermath==
The other surviving troopers of the Gloom Walkers quietly approved of Lucia's actions; they never reported her betrayal, and Ulabore was registered as having been killed in action.<ref name="Dynasty" />

[[980 BBY|Twenty-two years later]], Lucia&mdash;who had become a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]] of [[Doan]]&mdash;hired an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]], to [[Massacre on Doan|assassinate]] [[Gelba]], a leader of the [[Doan]] [[mining caste]], after the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] killed Serra's husband, Prince [[Gerran]]. Lucia compared the occurrence to her actions on Alaris Prime: Serra's husband had been killed and Gelba was responsible, so she killed Gelba, just as Dessel had been killed and Ulabore was responsible, so she had killed Ulabore. However, Lucia soon after discovered that Dessel had not actually been court-martialed and executed; rather, he had survived and become [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Bane, a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].<ref name="Dynasty" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish on Alaris Prime was mentioned in ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', the final novel of the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']], written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]]<ref name="Dynasty" /> and released on [[December 8]], [[2009]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
